Hi Lena — great to chat this morning.

Attached is a short proposal (pricing_proposal_v1.pdf) that blends a usage-first approach with an optional monthly commit. Key bullets: 
- No upfront lock for teams that prefer pure usage billing; per-token discounts kick in at monthly volume thresholds.
- Optional commit tiers (monthly) offer steeper per-token rebates and a modest rebate at renewal for multi-months.
- Invoices can include line-item exports (CSV) that break down tokens by model, route (text/generation, embedding), and direction (prompt/response).

Two asks so we can finalize:
1) Confirm whether procurement needs a fixed-term PO or prefer month-to-month with PO referencing HubSpot deal id.
2) Confirm the level of detail you need on invoices/exports (daily granularity? model-level?) — I included an export sample we can produce if helpful.

If useful I can loop in our finance lead (Vivek) and CS (Marissa) to sign off on the export format and commit tiers. Next available for a 30-min call: Thu 2/11 10:00–12:00 PST.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez

Diego / Vivek — quick answers and a recommended approach.

1) Invoice/export capability: yes, we can emit a daily CSV to a pre-authorized S3 bucket or provide a secure download link. Suggested CSV columns (export_sample_ellipsis.csv attached): 
   - date (YYYY-MM-DD)
   - model_name
   - api_route (chat/generate/embeddings)
   - prompt_tokens
   - response_tokens
   - tokens_total
   - price_per_1k
   - line_cost
   - hubspot_deal_id

We can also include an aggregated monthly summary file for quick reconciliation. Generating the CSV is supported today; if they want real-time streaming exports we can discuss, but S3 drop is standard.

2) Discount bands (recommended):
   - Tier A: 0–50M tokens / month — baseline (no discount)
   - Tier B: 50–250M tokens / month — 12% off baseline per-token price
   - Tier C: 250M+ tokens / month — 25% off baseline per-token price

   - Commit handling: monthly commit is a guaranteed spend; overages billed at the applicable usage tier for the month (not at committed rate). If they commit 6+ months we can improve Tier C to 30% for the commit period.

3) Formal quote and PO: we will produce a PDF quote that enumerates the commit options and an example invoice using their PO template. Include payment terms Net30 and Redwood's legal remit name.

4) Security / SOC2: send security questionnaires to security-requests@redwood.ai. We will provide the SOC2 Type II report via secure link after an NDA; SOC summary can be shared immediately.

Next steps (what to send to customer):
- Formal quote PDF that shows both month-to-month usage pricing and commit tiers (with the numbers above).
- Sample invoice CSV (attached) populated with Feb run-rate numbers as they requested.
- Link to SOC2 summary and security contact.

If you both approve I will assemble the quote and sample files and Diego can send to Ellipsis. Happy to join the call Thu 10:30 PST if you want to walk through.

— Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
